Relationship: Catwoman has strong feelings for Batman that can distract from her other goals. and duct-tape to bind and gag targets before she robs them, for example, and usually has a set of lockpicks on her person. While she prefers a more maneuverable motorcycle (better for the tight alleys of parts of Gotham) she has been known to drive various cars as well, often stolen.
